 Craig Meyer USA TODAY NETWORK Updated Nov. 15, 2026, 10:13 p.m. ET Hear this story A 2026 women's college soccer season that began in the sweltering, sticky August heat is nearing an end.
 And with it, we'll soon have a bracket.
 The 64-team bracket for the 2026 NCAA women's soccer tournament will be unveiled on Monday, Nov. 16, when dozens of eager teams from across the country will learn their postseason fates.
 REQUIRED READING: Div. I schools vote against making men's college soccer a two-semester sport Will programs like North Carolina , Vanderbilt , Michigan State and Ohio State be able to follow up on stellar regular seasons with a championship or, at the very least, a run to the Women's College Cup? Will reigning national champion Florida State be able to make a run after a 9-4-3 regular season and maybe even defend its title? Come Monday, what teams will see their dreams remain alive? And which ones will see their seasons come to a crushing end?
 Here's a look at USA TODAY Sports' projection for the 2026 NCAA women's soccer tournament:

 When is NCAA women's soccer selection show?
 Date: Monday, Nov. 16
 Time: 4 p.m. ET
 The NCAA women's soccer tournament selection show is scheduled to take place at 4 p.m. ET on Monday, Nov. 16.
 What TV channel is the NCAA women's soccer selection show on today?
 Streaming: NCAA.com
 The NCAA women's soccer tournament selection show will not air on linear television and will instead be streamed on the NCAA's website.
 NCAA women's soccer tournament dates

 Third round : Nov. 30
 Quarterfinals: Dec. 5
